description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that out‑performs Express & Fastify with built‑in security, AI‑ready routing, and edge‑optimized performance.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage 2026 buzzwords—edge‑runtime, AI‑ready, LLM integration, and zero‑trust security—while emphasizing a single‑dependency install. Position Yantravese as the "Express‑2.0" that developers can drop into any serverless or edge environment without polyfills, and highlight automatic OpenAPI generation and built‑in observability as must‑have features for modern cloud‑native stacks.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese for its **type‑safe routing** that catches bugs at compile time—something Express can’t promise.
Benchmarks show **sub‑microsecond latency** on edge runtimes, delivering up to **3× faster** request handling than Fastify in real‑world serverless workloads.
A **plug‑and‑play security suite** (CSP, rate‑limiting, CSRF, JWT) is built‑in, so you ship secure APIs without extra packages.
Zero‑dependency, **ESM‑only** design means instant startup on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, and Deno Deploy—no native builds required.
Automatic **OpenAPI/Swagger generation** and **AI‑ready hooks** let you generate docs and LLM‑driven assistants straight from your route definitions.
